description: Lists an app's community entries in any status; status "pending" is the approval queue. Returns metadata and stats, not the payload (neblla_get_community_entry). More: neblla_get_llms tools/list_community_entries

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

ownerId.description: Only this author: the per-app user id of neblla_list_users.

q.description: Text search over title, summary and tags.

sort.description: Default "gravity": the most serious pending entries first.

status.description: Only this status; left out, all.

name: neblla_list_community_entries
title: List community entries
